title: His labels and publishing companies: Enrica, Rae-Cox
summary: He owns Enrica and Rae-Cox labels and music companies, opened in 1959 at Broadway addresses.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: You played on a couple of records --
I played most of all -- Sometime I'd use Sam "The Man" Taylor on
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
one or two whenever I can get him, you know. George Kelly -- I used George Kelly on one.
A couple of these records have -- it says here, "Eddie Wilcox Orchestra." Were you a --

Same company, see. I owned both of those labels. Enrica and Rae-Cox, and Rae-Cox and Cook Publishing Company, Enrica Music Company, Enrica Records, (Inaudible) those two labels you got there, you know.
Those are -- when I got into that, that's when I opened up the publishing company. I have -- I brought these for you to see. I brought over --
Rae-Cox Records Incorporated, Enrica Records Incorporated, Enrica Music Incorporated, and Rae-Cox and Cook Music Corporation.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
So, you've always been in 1697 Broadway.
But you started out in 1674 Broadway.

No, we were -- we started -- We just moved back. We moved out then I moved back to 1697. We only been two places. We moved out of 1697. Then I went out on the road in '56. In 1956, I think I moved the publishing company over to 1674 because I went to -- right after that, I went on the road with that 'Walking The Blues' thing. I was out there for a year. And I came back and I reopened -- but I reopened in 1674 Broadway.
